scenarios.title: Open/Close Connection
scenarios.description: Open a connection to an app service that generates a random number between a min and max, then closes the connection by disposing the AppServiceConnection.

actions.name: GenerateRandomNumber
actions.expected: Opens connection, requests a random number in [min,max], shows it in Result, then closes the connection.

scenarios.title: Keep Connection Open
scenarios.description: Keep an AppServiceConnection open across multiple messages. Open Connection, then Generate Random Number repeatedly, then Close Connection.

actions.name: OpenConnection
actions.expected: Opens and keeps an app service connection open.

actions.name: GenerateRandomNumber
actions.expected: If a connection is open, returns a random number in [min,max]; otherwise reports that a connection must be opened first.
